source_caption:
🎬 An American Girl Story – Melody 1963: Love Has to Win (2016)

An American Girl Story – Melody 1963: Love Has to Win follows Melody Ellison, a bright and courageous 10-year-old African American girl growing up in Detroit, Michigan, during the Civil Rights Movement of the 1960s. Surrounded by a loving family and a community experiencing significant social change, Melody begins to understand the painful realities of racial discrimination, inequality, and prejudice while discovering the importance of standing up for what is right. Inspired by the courage of civil rights leaders and the determination of those fighting for equality, Melody struggles to make sense of the unfair treatment she witnesses in her everyday life. From difficult experiences at school and troubling encounters with discrimination to meaningful conversations with her family and moments of personal discovery, she learns that even young people can make a difference. As the struggle for civil rights intensifies, Melody must confront her fears, find her voice, and decide how to respond to hatred and injustice without losing her compassion for others. Through the guidance of her family and the strength of her community, she discovers that courage, kindness, and determination can inspire meaningful change. Combining heartfelt family drama, historical storytelling, emotional moments, and an inspiring message, the film explores equality, courage, identity, hope, and the power of love to overcome hatred.

🎭 Genre: Family • Drama • Historical

⭐ IMDb: 6.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 48 minutes • TV-Y7

🎥 Director: Tina Mabry

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video for current streaming availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: An American Girl Story – Melody 1963: Love Has to Win is a 2016 American drama film starring Marsai Martin in the title role, alongside Frances Fisher, Idara Victor and Frankie Faison in supporting roles. Set in Detroit, Michigan, during the Civil Rights Movement, the film revolves around African-American girl Melody Ellison, as she faces adversity and discrimination in her hometown and learns to overcome it through her creativity and imagination. The film is the first in the American Girl film series to be released exclusively on an online streaming service, and is Amazon Studios' first original special.
